changes: Created the minimal KakaoMap custom integration skeleton based on official HACS and Home Assistant documentation.
Added repository metadata, Korean README, English structure reference, and development cautions.
Implemented password-selector REST API key setup, validation, replacement, and reauthentication.
Added on-demand search_places response action with name/address keywords and normalized place coordinates.
Handled authentication, permission, quota, connection, and invalid-response failures without logging credentials.
Added Korean/English setup translations and documented current KakaoMap activation and rectangle-scope requirements.
Added get_route response action for public transport, walking, and bicycle travel using explicit WGS84 origin/destination coordinates.
Normalized distances, durations, fares, transfers, guidance, stop names, vehicle names, and route links without geometry.
Reused safe HTTP handling across place and route queries; added coordinate and routing-failure validation.
Documented action examples, conversation-tool composition, and unsupported route options.
Updated README to make public transport the default route behavior and reserve walking/bicycle routing for explicit user requests.
Added conversation examples, no automatic travel-mode fallback guidance, and a route action example with the mode omitted.
validation: Documentation-only change; checked UTF-8 without BOM, YAML example parsing, JSONL validity, and git diff whitespace.

changes: Registered an opt-in KakaoMap LLM API provider with config-entry-scoped cleanup and llm integration dependency.
Added namespaced place search, route lookup, and HA home location tools returning ToolResult objects.
Reused existing response actions and conversation context; added transit-default and explicit walking/cycling guidance.
Updated README with provider selection steps and installed HA conversation dependencies for actual APIInstance dispatch tests.
Updated conversation instructions to omit place and route URLs from spoken and text conversation responses while retaining URLs in action/tool response data.
Updated README to describe conversation link behavior.
Added per-entry HA persistent notifications for place/route authentication failures, including Assist tool calls.
Kept existing reauthentication behavior and dismissed only the matching alert after replacement key validation and save succeed.
Added persistent_notification dependency and documented on-demand error detection without assuming key expiration.
Added search_nearby response action and opt-in Assist tool using official Kakao keyword and category endpoints.
Required an explicit WGS84 center and exactly one keyword or category, with a default 1000m radius and five results, bounded at 20000m and fifteen results.
Returned numeric center distances in distance order and reused existing safe HTTP, authentication notification, and reauthentication handling.
Added Korean action selectors for all eighteen official categories, conversation center-resolution guidance, usage documentation, and structure metadata.
